name: 18_wipe_blue_paint
title: Wiping Blue Paint and Storing Sponge
summary: A robot arm wipes blue paint from a white table, deposits the used sponge into a container, and later reopens it to retrieve the sponge.
robot: one black robot arm with a parallel gripper
setting: a white tabletop workspace against a blue mottled wall

segments.instruction: Wipe the central blue paint spill using the sponge held in the gripper.
Scrub the remaining blue paint specks at the lower left edge until the table is clean.
Reach toward the upper workspace boundary and place a small plastic box with an open lid onto the table.
Drop the sponge into the box and press the lid shut.
segments.memory_event: hide: the paint-stained sponge inside the closed box

segments.instruction: Move the gripper across the wiped tabletop area to inspect the surface.
Tap the center of the clean table with the closed gripper tips.
Open the box on the table.
segments.memory_event: return: the paint-stained sponge resting inside the box exactly as dropped

segments.instruction: Take out what you put in the box and hold it above the table.
